source.section: Chapter 4: Rank – Starfleet Enlisted Crew; Starfleet Officers

note: Starfleet officer ranks, lowest first (the book lists them highest first). Notes are the book's text. The only assignment minimum rank (Commanding Officer: Commander) lives in assignments.json.

ranks.name: Cadet
ranks.note: Starfleet Academy students are referred to as cadets, usually with their year (first-year cadet, third-year cadet, etc.). Upon graduation, cadets are commissioned as ensigns, or rarely, as lieutenants (junior grade).

ranks.name: Ensign
ranks.note: This is the lowest rank available to any commissioned officer.

ranks.name: Lieutenant (junior grade)
ranks.note: This rank is the highest rank that may be taken by an officer with the Untapped Potential talent.

ranks.name: Lieutenant Commander
ranks.note: This rank is the lowest rank that may be taken by an officer with the Veteran talent. Commonly referred to as “commander” for brevity.

ranks.name: Commander
ranks.note: This is the lowest rank a commanding officer may have under normal circumstances.

ranks.name: Captain
ranks.note: Most commanding officers hold this rank; commanding officers who do not are often referred to as captains out of tradition.

ranks.name: Fleet Captain
ranks.note: Fleet captain is a rare rank given to the most respected captains. Sometimes this is an honorary title more than an actual rank.

ranks.name: Commodore
ranks.note: Flag officer. Occasionally this rank is referred to as “rear admiral, lower half.”

enlistedNote: Enlisted ranks, lowest first (the book lists them highest first). All enlisted crew are outranked by any commissioned officer. The book gives classes (1st, 2nd, 3rd) for Crewman and Petty Officer and duty titles for Crewman only; the prototype uses the rank name only.

enlistedRanks.name: Crewman
enlistedRanks.note: Crewman (1st class, 2nd class, or 3rd class). Often, personnel of this rank will be addressed by a title according to their duties, such as boatswain (pronounced “bo’sun”), specialist, technician, or yeoman.

enlistedRanks.name: Petty Officer
enlistedRanks.note: Petty officer (1st class, 2nd class, or 3rd class). Non-commissioned officer. The highest rank that can be taken by an enlisted character with the Untapped Potential talent.

enlistedRanks.name: Chief Petty Officer
enlistedRanks.note: Non-commissioned officer. Normally addressed as chief. This is the lowest rank that may be taken by an enlisted character with the Veteran talent.

enlistedRanks.name: Senior Chief Petty Officer
enlistedRanks.note: Non-commissioned officer. Normally addressed as chief.

enlistedRanks.name: Master Chief Petty Officer
enlistedRanks.note: The most senior non-commissioned officer (NCO). Normally addressed as master chief or simply chief.
